Beg to differ, anon. it is addressed. The TL;DR would basically be: yes, Jews are a big fucking problem, but even they are ultimately subject to an all-encompassing problem known as the Technical complex, or the techno-industrial system, or technology, whatever you want to call it. 
>he thinks nazis were bad.
Anon, I-
They did kill a whole bunch of fucking people and invade a whole bunch of countries.... Please don't misinterpret, th Jews are a literal cultural cancer, and th National Socialists did have many noble and forward-thinking characteristics, but it is understandable that they may be seen as 'bad', as you put it....
Also, Ted says that Hitler was the only Revolutionary that actually stuck to his initial plan and didn't backtrack or betray his ideas once he attained power. 
That is definitely worth something,and clearly speaks favorably about his character and leadership. 
>The mechanisms are fine. The problems we can fix. That's the point.
No way. technical solutions to technical problems are no solution at all, very much on the contrary.
>Whites made all this technology for a reason, and if you somehow managed to get rid of it all, we would just make it again. 
No, once it collapses, it will almost certainly never come back.
